file_name: Australian Venue Co - assets of The Breakwater, Hillarys and Print Hall, Perth - third-party questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if any of AVC’s existing venues compete closely with either The Breakwater or Print Hall and there are not many alternatives.
List which venues you consider to be alternatives to each of Print Hall and The Breakwater.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Australian Venue Co and/or The Breakwater or Print Hall.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
